capabilities: Record moods, moments, thoughts, and plans through four capture tabs
Browse and filter past entries in a waterfall card review mode
Extract dates from natural language when adding plan to-dos
Paste or upload images into journal entries
Switch between three UI styles and eight color themes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a full Chinese-language section and promotes the author's Xiaohongshu, WeChat, and Douyin channels.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structured journaling interface for quickly logging moods, thoughts, and plans with review and filtering.
summary: Journaling plugin that captures moods, moments, thoughts, and plans into daily Markdown files, with a card-based review mode and themed UI.
